questions.question: Which statement matches the textbook definition of globalization?
options: Globalization is the replacement of local cultures by one universal culture.

Globalization is solely the spread of western politics to developing countries.
Globalization means the end of national governments and rise of a single world government.
questions.answer: Globalization refers to the multiplicity of linkages and interconnections between states and societies making events in one place affect distant parts of the globe.
questions.explanation: The excerpt defines globalization as multiplicity of linkages and interconnections so that events and activities in one part can have consequences in distant parts of the globe.
